description: Source code for the Popup_Picker class in the Activities module of SuiteCRM, responsible for retrieving and displaying activity records such as tasks, meetings, calls, emails, and notes for a given module. Includes methods for processing page data, formatting details, and rendering the popup template.

classes.name: Popup_Picker
classes.description: A class for handling the display and processing of activity popups within the SuiteCRM Activities module. Manages retrieval of linked records, formatting of activity details, and rendering of the popup interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the Popup_Picker class. Currently empty.

methods.name: process_page
methods.description: Main method that retrieves linked activities, processes data, and renders the popup page template.

methods.name: getEmailDetails
methods.description: Generates a detailed HTML string for an email record, including recipients and message snippet.

methods.name: getTaskDetails
methods.description: Returns formatted details for a task, including start date and description.

methods.name: formatDescription
methods.description: Converts new line characters in text to HTML line breaks for display.
